name: runbook-os-updates
description: OS package updates on a host: a report of pending updates (security first) and the host's maintenance windows, then - only inside a maintenance window - approval, applying the updates, and verification (services healthy, whether a reboot is needed). Outside a window it stops after the report.

in_window.description: true when the host is inside one of its maintenance windows now

report.title: Pending updates
report.prompt:
Host {{input.host}}. Read-only: detect the package manager (ssh_exec: cat /etc/os-release), list pending updates (apt list --upgradable / dnf check-update / apk version -l '<'), mark the security ones, note kernel or libc updates (they need a reboot), and check the host's maintenance windows with ops_inventory list (it shows IN MAINTENANCE NOW). Security only: {{input.security_only}}.
Plan the exact update command (e.g. sudo -n apt-get -y upgrade, or only the security packages).

Report: the pending updates (count, security ones by name), the exact command, whether a reboot will be needed, and whether the host is in a maintenance window now.

approve.title: Approve applying updates
approve.message:
Apply these OS updates on {{input.host}} now (inside its maintenance window)?

{{state.report}}

apply.title: Apply updates
apply.prompt:
A person approved the update on {{input.host}}:
{{state.report}}

Run exactly the planned update command with ssh_exec as: "operator" (timeout_sec up to 600), once. Do not reboot.

Report: the command, its exit status and the packages it upgraded.

verify.title: Verify
verify.prompt:
Verify the update on {{input.host}}: no pending updates of the kind applied remain, the services on the host are healthy (probe, ops_check, docker_status / systemctl --failed via host_stats), and whether a reboot is required (/var/run/reboot-required or needs-restarting -r) - a needed reboot is a separate, approved change, not part of this run. VERIFIED or FAILED.

Report: the checks, and whether a reboot is needed.

outside-window.title: Reported only: not in a maintenance window
